礼物与收礼人关联的理由

author_positive_body: I would recommend a paper-cut picture of flowers for your mother. Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese craft, and a flower design would connect it with her interest in gardening. Choose one mounted on a simple card, so it will be easy to carry home. You could add a short note explaining why you chose the pattern. That personal message may matter as much as the gift itself. I hope she enjoys it and that you have a pleasant journey home.
author_negative_body: Buying gifts is an important part of travelling. There are many shops near the station, and they often stay open until late in the evening. You should compare prices carefully and check how much space is left in your suitcase. Remember to keep your passport and ticket somewhere safe. If the weather is cold, wear a warm coat on the way to the airport. I think travelling abroad is a useful experience because it helps us understand different ways of life.
